reference.title: Margins, padding and borders
reference.shortdesc: This reference lists the properties that CSSMedia uses for the margins, padding, borders and rounded corners of a box.

row.entry: Sets the space outside the four sides of the box. One value applies to all sides. Two values set top and bottom, then left and right. Three set top, then left and right, then bottom. Four set top, right, bottom and left.
One to four lengths or percentages, or auto
Sets the space above the box.
A length, a percentage or auto
Sets the space at the right of the box.
A length, a percentage or auto
Sets the space below the box.
A length, a percentage or auto
Sets the space at the left of the box.
A length, a percentage or auto
Sets the margins at the start and the end of the block axis.
One or two lengths, percentages or auto
Sets the margin at the start of the block axis.
A length, a percentage or auto
Sets the margin at the end of the block axis.
A length, a percentage or auto
Sets the margins at the start and the end of the inline axis.
One or two lengths, percentages or auto
Sets the margin at the start of the inline axis.
A length, a percentage or auto
Sets the margin at the end of the inline axis.
A length, a percentage or auto
Chooses what happens to the margins of a box where a page or column break touches them.
auto, keep or discard
Removes the margins of the children that touch the edges of the container.
none, block, inline, or one or more of block-start, block-end, inline-start and inline-end
Sets the space between the content and the border on the four sides. The values are read like those of margin.
